title: How to make show-more button in hierarchicalMenu?

comments.body: There's a full example here, where did you get a 404? https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/hierarchical-menu/js/#full-example

The link is available on the `v2` branch: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/dev/app/jquery/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.js.
